create_agent: create an agent_lib.Agent instance for a given task_id with optional UI or headless server binary
build_agent_task_client: build an AgentApiTaskClient that manages MJPC task resources with a headless or interactive UI agent
run_task_client_reset: run a task client reset to return the simulation to its starting position
run_task_client_execute_plan: run a task client execute_plan to simulate MJPC for a specified duration while executing planner actions
test_task_client_update_state: test the task client update_state method to sync MuJoCo MjData with the latest agent binary state
